originalTitle: Viral vodka brand Au set to sell for £500m to BuzzBallz owner
summary: The distinctive gold Au bottles have become a staple of poolside parties in Ibiza and Dubai.
content:
Co-founders Charlie Morgan and Jackson Quinn will reportedly make over £100m each from the sale of the business

The viral Welsh vodka firm Au Vodka is nearing a £500m sale to Southern Comfort and BuzzBallz owner Sazerac.

Sazerac told BBC Wales in a statement it had agreed to buy the vodka start-up, with the deal, first reported by Sky News, expected to earn Swansea-based founders Charlie Morgan and Jackson Quinn over £100m each.

Former Swansea City ball boy Charlie Morgan, who hit the headlines in 2013 after he was kicked by Chelsea's Eden Hazard during a cup semi-final, and his childhood friend Jackson Quinn founded the company in 2015.

The founders declined to discuss the deal, while the owner of the canned cocktail BuzzBallz , Sazerac, said it would allow it "to deepen its presence in the UK".

Two years after launching the vodka firm, Morgan and Quinn accepted investment from DJ Charlie Sloth whose celebrity contacts brought valuable endorsements to the gold-coloured vodka bottles.

YouTube star Jake Paul had a tattoo of an Au Vodka bottle as part of a publicity stunt, while the gold bottles became a staple of poolside parties in Ibiza and Dubai.

The company developed ready-to-drink cans that kept the distinctive gold branding and became one of the most popular products on the market.

In 2025 they opened a new headquarters on an industrial estate in their home city of Swansea, turning an office block into a car park full of gold-wrapped cars, while visitors enjoyed a nine-hole mini golf course with golden obstacles and balls.

Morgan earned infamy as the Swansea City ball boy who was kicked by Eden Hazard during a game with Chelsea in 2013

It is quite a journey for co-founder Morgan, whose early fame came aged 17 when he was kicked by Chelsea's Hazard during the side's game against Swansea City in 2013.

The teenager fell to the ground as Hazard attempted to get the ball from him, with the Blues midfielder then trying to kick it from under him, but instead he appeared to make contact with the youngster.

Hazard was sent off for the kick at the Liberty Stadium, and later apologised, but the incident prompted widespread debate among football fans, players and pundits about who was at fault.

Ten years later, as Morgan's business boomed, he reunited with Hazard for a YouTube video where they laughed about the incident.

Morgan and Quinn took a serious approach to their business, despite the bling and celebrity bluster.

Having moved quickly into the ready-to-drink market as it boomed following the pandemic, Au Vodka became second only to BuzzBallz in the UK.

Morgan, whose father Martin Morgan is a director of Swansea City football club and owns the city's Morgan's Hotel, told BBC Wales News in 2025 that he had his eyes set further afield, and was expanding aggressively into the US market.

Speaking last year, Morgan said: "If you asked a 25-year-old target market consumer in America, would they know Au? Probably not yet," he said.

"So there's still so many more people who don't know about us. And I think we're still driven to try and take over the world a little bit more."

In 2025 the Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) found Au Vodka broke rules by inappropriately aiming the alcohol at people under 18 in a social media promotion, and banned the advert featuring a Love Island contestant from TikTok.

chineseTitle: 病毒式伏特加品牌 Au 将以 5 亿英镑的价格出售给 BuzzBallz 所有者
chineseSummary: 独特的金金瓶已成为伊维萨岛和迪拜池畔派对的必备品。
chineseContent:
据报道，联合创始人查理·摩根和杰克逊·奎恩将通过出售该业务每人获得超过 1 亿英镑

威尔士伏特加公司 Au Vodka 即将以 5 亿英镑的价格出售给 Southern Comfort 和 BuzzBallz 的所有者 Sazerac。

萨泽拉克在一份声明中告诉英国广播公司威尔士公司，它已同意收购这家伏特加初创公司，这笔交易首先由天空新闻报道，预计将为斯旺西的创始人查理·摩根和杰克逊·奎恩各赚取超过 1 亿英镑。

前斯旺西城球童查理·摩根 (Charlie Morgan) 因在杯赛半决赛中被切尔西队的伊登·阿扎尔 (Eden Hazard) 踢倒而成为 2013 年的头条新闻，他的儿时好友杰克逊·奎恩 (Jackson Quinn) 于 2015 年创立了该公司。

创始人拒绝讨论这笔交易，而罐装鸡尾酒 BuzzBallz 的所有者 Sazerac 表示，这将使其“加深在英国的业务”。

创办伏特加公司两年后，摩根和奎因接受了 DJ Charlie Sloth 的投资，后者的名人关系为金色伏特加酒瓶带来了宝贵的认可。

YouTube 明星杰克·保罗 (Jake Paul) 纹身了金伏特加酒瓶，作为宣传噱头的一部分，而金瓶则成为伊维萨岛和迪拜池畔派对的必备品。

该公司开发的即饮罐保留了独特的金色品牌，成为市场上最受欢迎的产品之一。

2025 年，他们在家乡斯旺西的一个工业区开设了新总部，将办公楼变成了停满金色汽车的停车场，而游客则可以享受设有金色障碍物和球的九洞迷你高尔夫球场。

摩根因2013年与切尔西的比赛中被伊登·阿扎尔踢倒斯旺西城球童而声名狼藉

对于联合创始人摩根来说，这是一段相当漫长的旅程，他早年成名，当时他 17 岁，在 2013 年切尔西队对阵斯旺西城的比赛中被切尔西队的阿扎尔踢倒。

当阿扎尔试图从他手中接球时，这名少年摔倒在地，蓝军中场随后试图从他身下踢球，但他似乎与这名年轻人发生了接触。

阿扎尔在自由体育场因踢球被罚下场，后来道歉，但这一事件引发了球迷、球员和专家之间关于谁的过错的广泛争论。

十年后，随着摩根的生意蓬勃发展，他与阿扎尔在 YouTube 上重聚，拍摄了一段视频，他们在视频中嘲笑了这一事件。

尽管有金光闪闪和名人的夸夸其谈，摩根和奎因仍认真对待他们的生意。

随着疫情爆发后的即饮市场蓬勃发展，Au Vodka 迅速进入了即饮市场，在英国成为仅次于 BuzzBallz 的第二大伏特加。

摩根的父亲马丁·摩根是斯旺西城足球俱乐部的董事，并拥有该市的摩根酒店。摩根在 2025 年告诉 BBC 威尔士新闻，他的目光放得更远，正在积极进军美国市场。

去年，摩根表示：“如果你问美国 25 岁的目标市场消费者，他们会认识 Au 吗？可能还不会，”他说。

“所以还有很多人不了解我们。而且我认为我们仍然有动力尝试更多地接管世界。”

2025 年，广告标准局 (ASA) 发现 Au Vodka 在社交媒体促销中不适当地针对 18 岁以下人群，违反了规定，并禁止了 TikTok 上爱情岛选手的广告。
